privacy changes require the current password

republication cannot release the independent hold or rewrite historical retention

held overdue response is excluded from scheduled-expiry eligibility
released overdue response becomes eligible for retention cleanup

retention cleanup removes actual stored answer values
retention cleanup retry performs no duplicate deletion
